title: Calculate customer order balances
summary: Aggregate paid charges and refunds per customer, ignoring pending orders.
requirements: Each row has customerId (string), amountCents (nonnegative safe integer), and status: paid, refunded, or pending.
Add paid amounts, subtract refunded amounts, and ignore pending amounts.
Include every customer present in the input even when their final balance is zero.
Return { customerId, balanceCents } rows sorted lexicographically by customerId.
Throw an Error containing "Invalid order" for unknown statuses, blank customerIds, or invalid amountCents.
hints: An accumulator keyed by customerId avoids nested loops.
Map paid to +amount, refunded to -amount, and pending to 0.
Convert the accumulator to an array and sort the customer IDs before returning.
